text:
alex: heads up — nightly quant tests just turned red on h100-pool. one shard had a sudden alloc spike and OOM during the attention warmup. failing job: build 5421 / shard 7.
ci-bot: build #5421 failed on worker h100-08 (zone us-west2). exit: OOM, last log lines attached.
maria: can you paste the last 20 lines from the job log? also which quant profile was used?
alex: sending snippet: 
```
2026-03-17 02:10:15 INFO kernel: starting attention kernel
2026-03-17 02:10:16 WARN allocator: high-water 46.3 GB
2026-03-17 02:10:17 ERROR runtime: allocation failed: out of memory
stack: aten::empty_cuda -> aten::native_dropout -> model::attention::forward
```
alex: profile: l4-qint8-fast (auto-selected). sequence len ~2048 for this test.
tara: odd — sequence len usually 512 in our nightly. did the test input change?
sam: I saw a PR that bumped the prompt in eval harness earlier today, @maria can you check?
maria: yes, PR #1887 increased sequence to 2048 for stress coverage. it passed on local a100 but h100 CI shows surge.
alex: looks like kernel ramp then allocator hit high-water and then OOM. I suspect a driver or cuda runtime difference + kernel memory estimate bug.
tara: can we do a quick smoke: re-run the failing shard on a different h100 host, and run with CUDA_DRIVER=default vs pinned? also try force smaller batch or shorter seq to see if it's deterministic.
sam: I'll kick a rerun with added logs and CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 on h100-12 now. tag me if it goes red again.
ci-bot: triggered rerun: build #5421.1 on h100-12 by sam.
ci-bot: note: node h100-12 has driver 535.86; h100-08 had driver 535.85.
alex: aha — driver micro-diff. could explain different kernel path. can we also try with the same driver as h100-08 (535.85) on a clean node?
tara: infra: can you spin up an instance with 535.85 and repro? if not, we'll try to bisect by reverting the PR that changed sequence length and re-run.
infra-bot: request accepted. provisioning h100-13 with driver 535.85, ETA ~6m.
maria: if repro happens only with seq=2048 then temporary mitigation is to cap nightly to 1024 until we finalize.
sam: rerun finished: still failed but now shows a smaller leak pattern before OOM. attaching small trace.
alex: thanks. next steps: 1) infra repro on 535.85 (in progress), 2) run failing shard with seq=512 to confirm input size causality, 3) if repro on 535.85, open a kernel-level issue and tag eng-runtime.
tara: assigning eng-runtime ping to @alex and @sam. i'll post a short JIRA with logs. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: jira ticket created: RINF-1123 - h100 alloc jitter leading to OOM on quant attention test.
maria: agree on temp cap to 1024 for nightly. i'll push change after infra confirms repro.
alex: thanks everyone — will update thread when infra repro lands.
